thread.title: AMS joins list of Apple suppliers trimming outlooks

author: morningstar.com
title: AMS joins list of Apple suppliers trimming outlooks
text:
AMS AG cut its forecast late Wednesday, adding to a number of Apple Inc. (AAPL) suppliers cutting outlooks because of lower-than-expected sales. AMS said it sees fourth-quarter revenue of $480 million to $520 million, down from its forecast of $570 million to $610 million made in late October, because of "recent demand changes from a major consumer customer." Analysts surveyed by FactSet had estimated revenue of $617.6 million. Over the week, suppliers Lumentum Holdings Inc. (LITE) and Qorvo Inc. (QRVO)warned of lower-than-expected sales (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/apples-stock-flirts-with-bear-market-after-guggenheim-cuts-rating-earnings-outlook-2018-11-14).
-Wallace Witkowski; 1905ET
